codeReview.summary: The commit improves FarmCard styling, but it does not fully redesign the farms list screen described in the feature. The main screen layout in app/(tabs)/farms.tsx remains the old search-first/quick-stats composition, and populated iOS screens still lose the add-farm action entirely.

issues.description: The target screen itself was not redesigned to the wireframe structure. SearchHeader still renders a search bar plus quick-stat cards (see lines 76-145), and ListHeaderComponent wires that unchanged header into the list (line 545), but the wireframe/feature description requires an in-content 26px Farms title, trailing search/add actions, and a one-line summary before the cards.

The add-farm control disappears on populated iOS/non-Android screens. showFab is gated by isAndroid, so the only add button for non-empty lists is Android-only; the remaining add buttons are limited to loading and empty states. The feature description and wireframe require a persistent add-farm button/FAB on the farms list.

The area badge tint is hard-coded to 0.08 opacity in all themes. The dark wireframe specifies a stronger rgba(74,139,107,0.15) pill, so dark mode cards will render a noticeably lighter-than-spec area badge.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The validation contract for farms-list-redesign is too narrow for the feature description. It checks only farm-card styling and search UI, but it never asserts the required screen header/summary/add-CTA work, which allowed an incomplete screen implementation to pass validation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:807 requires HEADER and ADD FARM UI for app/(tabs)/farms.tsx, while validation-contract.md:135-143 only defines VAL-FARMLIST-001 (card) and VAL-FARMLIST-002 (search input).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The ui-worker procedure requires reading both the light and dark wireframes, but this worker session only referenced the light farms-list wireframe. That gap is consistent with the dark-mode badge mismatch left in FarmCard.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: ui-worker SKILL.md Step 2 requires both wireframes; transcript inspection for worker session 047ffda4-3381-4bdf-a9a2-127dbda0aaae contains wireframe-farms-list.html but not wireframe-farms-list-dark.html, while src/components/cards/farm-card.tsx:205 keeps the light-mode 0.08 badge tint in dark mode too.
